continuation.objective: Continue recurring read-only monitoring of O's canonical durable human-request queue and notify only new, materially changed, or reopened unresolved requests.
continuation.exact_next_action: On the next invocation, bootstrap from latest authenticated note control, read current O main agi/USER_REQUEST_QUEUE.json, compare one bounded deterministic slice against this successful baseline, persist and exact-read back the successor role-local baseline/receipt, then return normally; notify only on a new, materially changed, or reopened unresolved request.
do_not_repeat: Do not notify the two currently open requests again unless their human-request meaning materially changes or they reopen after resolution.
Do not treat reevaluate_by, review provenance, safe-alternative-work, or unrelated O repository activity alone as a notification trigger.
Do not mutate O, its queue, primary authority, or any scheduler.
Do not start a second semantic comparison unit in the same invocation.
